items.text: Livestock headbutt damage increased, making them more dangerous in close combat.

items.text: Fixed pregnant cows getting stuck between follow and play states.
Animals now avoid obstacles more reliably.
Wild sheep now flee when a player attempts to shave them.
Added new bull and cow trophy models.

Overhauled sheep shearing: fleece persists after server restarts, shearing no longer counts as combat, knives wound instead of shearing, correct wool payout, timers recover after saves, wool goes to backpack, fur baking limited to fleece models, and shearing works with any harvesting item (including new material), fixing lost‑state bugs.
Renamed raw, cooked, and spoiled "Lamb" meat to "Mutton".
Wild cows no longer breed, age, or produce resources; pregnancies only possible when condition is at least 60%.
Respawnable fridges now assign a new first looter after items respawn.
Loadout items retain their positions when creating or deploying loadouts.
Grenades now support mask interactions, influencing visibility and targeting.
Added dedicated subsystems for many player tools (megaphone, mobile phone, compass, detonator, master key, water pistols, keycards), removing unnecessary holdtypes and overrides.
Boat vendor dialogue now correctly indicates the direction to the purchased boat.
Livestock interaction popup repositioned to the right side, matching plant popups and keeping the model visible.
Skateboard cow durability increased, reducing breakage during use.
Crab swarms now move together with varied speeds based on size, improving their behavior.
Water height calculations corrected, fixing NaN issues that could cause abnormal water levels.

2026-09-18.summary:
### Livestock & Wildlife
- Fixed pregnant cows getting stuck between follow and play states.
- Animals now avoid obstacles more reliably.
- Wild sheep now flee when a player attempts to shave them.
- Added new bull and cow trophy models.
- Overhauled sheep shearing: fleece persists after server restarts, shearing no longer counts as combat, knives wound instead of shearing, correct wool payout, timers recover after saves, wool goes to backpack, fur baking limited to fleece models, and shearing works with any harvesting item (including new material), fixing lost‑state bugs.
- Renamed raw, cooked, and spoiled "Lamb" meat to "Mutton".
- Wild cows no longer breed, age, or produce resources; pregnancies only possible when condition is at least 60%.

### Inventory & Loot
- Respawnable fridges now assign a new first looter after items respawn.
- Loadout items retain their positions when creating or deploying loadouts.

### Combat & Tools
- Grenades now support mask interactions, influencing visibility and targeting.
- Added dedicated subsystems for many player tools (megaphone, mobile phone, compass, detonator, master key, water pistols, keycards), removing unnecessary holdtypes and overrides.

### UI & Dialogue
- Boat vendor dialogue now correctly indicates the direction to the purchased boat.
- Livestock interaction popup repositioned to the right side, matching plant popups and keeping the model visible.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Skateboard cow durability increased, reducing breakage during use.
- Crab swarms now move together with varied speeds based on size, improving their behavior.
- Water height calculations corrected, fixing NaN issues that could cause abnormal water levels.

items.text: Remotely controlled turrets can now damage reactive targets, fixing a limitation where they only reacted to client projectiles.
Distance2D calculations now correctly use true 2‑D distance, fixing range‑related bugs.
Low‑health heartbeat sound now ramps up with intensity and fades after 3 seconds of health loss, making danger more noticeable.
Rich versions of all pies now require cream and grant extra duration, higher yield, healing, max HP and other buffs.
Brioche Bread recipe adds a 25 % boost to bread stats and requires eggs and cream.
Key recipe costs reduced (stone and cloth) and crafting time cut from 30 s to 10 s.
Water‑level generation no longer produces NaN values, eliminating water‑height glitches.
Triangle foundations no longer incorrectly connect buildings that only touch at a corner.
Seat‑swap action added across all vehicle controls and a consistent car reload button binding introduced.
Stirring a biofuel generator mounts the player at their position; releasing E stops mounting, and a ‘no electricity’ status appears if the generator lacks power.
Livestock spread out when feeding to avoid crowding the trough, and sheep corpse colliders now behave correctly.
Navmesh generation issues fixed, preventing meshes on fences and improving NPC pathing.
New achievements added for mailing a note to another player, buying from the travelling vendor, and triggering a satellite crash event.
Quick join menu now reliably shows server entries without disappearing.
Quick join menu now displays entries (previously empty).
Painting UI now includes a colour wheel for neon signs, larger size option (up to 25mm), and optional brush outline toggle for better visibility.
Sheep charge attack animation fixed, ensuring proper attack behavior.
Toggle duck feature works correctly on non-modular car vehicles.
Flexbox UI layout error resolved, preventing out-of-range crashes in UI panels.

2026-09-17.summary:
### Combat & Targeting
- Remotely controlled turrets can now damage reactive targets, fixing a limitation where they only reacted to client projectiles.
- Distance2D calculations now correctly use true 2‑D distance, fixing range‑related bugs.
- Low‑health heartbeat sound now ramps up with intensity and fades after 3 seconds of health loss, making danger more noticeable.

### Crafting & Food Buffs
- Rich versions of all pies now require cream and grant extra duration, higher yield, healing, max HP and other buffs.
- Brioche Bread recipe adds a 25 % boost to bread stats and requires eggs and cream.
- Key recipe costs reduced (stone and cloth) and crafting time cut from 30 s to 10 s.

### World & Environment
- Water‑level generation no longer produces NaN values, eliminating water‑height glitches.
- Triangle foundations no longer incorrectly connect buildings that only touch at a corner.

### Vehicles & Controls
- Seat‑swap action added across all vehicle controls and a consistent car reload button binding introduced.
- Stirring a biofuel generator mounts the player at their position; releasing E stops mounting, and a ‘no electricity’ status appears if the generator lacks power.

### Livestock & AI
- Livestock spread out when feeding to avoid crowding the trough, and sheep corpse colliders now behave correctly.
- Navmesh generation issues fixed, preventing meshes on fences and improving NPC pathing.

### Achievements
- New achievements added for mailing a note to another player, buying from the travelling vendor, and triggering a satellite crash event.

### Multiplayer & Matchmaking
- Quick join menu now reliably shows server entries without disappearing.
- Quick join menu now displays entries (previously empty).

### Building & Creative
- Painting UI now includes a colour wheel for neon signs, larger size option (up to 25mm), and optional brush outline toggle for better visibility.

### Combat & Animations
- Sheep charge attack animation fixed, ensuring proper attack behavior.

### Vehicle Controls
- Toggle duck feature works correctly on non-modular car vehicles.

### UI Stability
- Flexbox UI layout error resolved, preventing out-of-range crashes in UI panels.
